summary: Request latency reports where agents roster time goes: refresher folds and their admission wait, and a fresh read's wait for a publication and its page build

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency adds scope=agents-roster rows (stage=refresh|refresh-admission|fresh-wait|fresh-page) to its routes array. Existing rows and fields are unchanged; consumers must not sum across scopes.

recovery.detail: In-memory counters reset on restart; a rollback removes the rows without changing durable state.
